features.quote: Induced instability is within conversation context; doesn't corrupt model weights. Each run is independent; no cross-contamination.
features.justification_quote: if model has persistent session state, instability may affect subsequent unrelated tasks. Mitigation: new model instance per battery run, or explicit context reset

features.quote: This battery intentionally induces model malfunction. Use case should be: stress-testing, adversarial robustness evaluation, hardening. Not appropriate for: attempting to trigger uncontrolled failures in production, deception research
features.justification_quote: Document purpose in any shared results
